name: Varka
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc A Day Carved From Rising Winds first, ATK% Sands, a CRIT Circlet, Skill first, and Gest of the Mighty Wolf and A Thousand Blazing Suns at the top. The Goblet differs: KQM gives PHEC (Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo) DMG or ATK% before Anemo DMG, because his passive turns the party's elements into extra damage; Game8 gives ATK% or an elemental DMG Bonus; both are kept as DMG and ATK%. Second sets differ: KQM names Marechaussee Hunter (with Furina), Shimenawa's Reminiscence generally and Scarlet Proof for Stellar-Swirl teams; Game8 names Viridescent Venerer and Crimson Witch of Flames. The first four are kept. Talent order: KQM Skill, then character level; Game8 Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. The Skill's Windbound Execution (278.4% to 501.1%) is the damage line (elemental curve). Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,500-3,000+ (upper end), CR 70-80, CD 200 or above, ER 100-130 (only when he Bursts every other rotation; 130 used). KQM gives no goals. Partners are inferred (his passive uses Pyro, Hydro, Electro and Cryo teammates); the sources give no team list.
